translations.web: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”
translations.bsb: And a second time they called out: “Hallelujah! Her smoke rises forever and ever.”
translations.kjv: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
translations.asv: And a second time they say, Hallelujah. And her smoke goeth up for ever and ever.
